title: Innistrad: Crimson Vow Promos: card flavor text

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A vampire who holds a grand wedding to unite the vampire bloodlines under her rule and guards it with red invitation envelopes.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: An angel who tears free from her bindings while Olivia is distracted and summons her Host of Herons.

entities.name: Thalia
entities.description: A defender of Thraben who vows not to rest until it is cleansed.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: A city that Thalia says belongs to the living.

entities.name: Geralf
entities.description: A stitcher who builds horrors and speaks to his sister; Ludevic's notes say his prowess is growing.

entities.name: Ludevic
entities.description: A creator whose laboratory notes record that Geralf can now replicate his creations with near-perfect accuracy.

entities.name: Jacob Hauken
entities.description: An inspector who observes that the world is dark but still has plenty to see.

entities.name: York
entities.description: A Kessig tracker who is nervous about a murder of crows.

entities.name: Ormendahl
entities.description: A demon who offers humans power at a price and refuses negotiation.

entities.name: Henrika
entities.description: A vampire who praises the taste of demon blood.

entities.name: Marel
entities.description: A Dawnhart witch who speaks of molding change with faith and fortitude.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A speaker who says seeds waited faithfully for the sun to rise again.

entities.name: Halana
entities.description: A Kessig ranger who wants to follow a dangerous unknown creature.

entities.name: Alena
entities.description: A Kessig trapper who wants to run from the Ulvenwald Behemoth.

entities.name: Dorothea
entities.description: A victim who cannot rest while a Voldaren draws breath.

entities.name: Edgar
entities.description: A vampire who says his kind has taken his gift for granted.

entities.name: Eruth
entities.description: A prophet cursed with visions of monsters and suffering that all come true.

entities.name: Voldaren
entities.description: A vampire bloodline to which Olivia belongs, hated by Dorothea.

entities.name: Host of Herons
entities.description: The flock of herons Sigarda summons.

entities.name: Lurenbraum
entities.description: A barrier that only holders of red envelopes may pass.

entities.name: Nephalia
entities.description: A region whose coast is shaped by violent storms and whose tides obey an unforgiving moon.

entities.name: Kessig
entities.description: A region home to trackers, rangers, trappers and wolfriders.

entities.name: Moorlands
entities.description: The land where the Headless Rider wanders.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where the wedding and these events take place.

entities.name: Quietus Cult
entities.description: A cult that holds grim ceremonies where unburied dead litter the ground.

entities.name: Headless Rider
entities.description: A rider who wanders the Moorlands hoping to take a head worthy of replacing his own.

entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: A region where vampires have taken from villagers who now rise up.

events.summary: Olivia orders that wedding guests need red envelopes to pass the Lurenbraum barrier, with no exceptions.
events.quote: Olivia left strict instructions: no invitation, no entry, no exceptions.

events.summary: While Olivia is distracted, Sigarda tears free from her bindings and summons her Host of Herons.
events.quote: With Olivia distracted, Sigarda tore free from her bindings and summoned her Host of Herons.

events.summary: Thalia vows not to rest until Thraben is cleansed.
events.quote: I will not rest until it is cleansed.

events.summary: Vampires of every bloodline gather at the wedding, the event of the century.
events.quote: Vampires from every bloodline mingled together

events.summary: Geralf shows his sister a horror inspired by her own face.
events.quote: Its dreadful visage was inspired by your own.

events.summary: Ludevic notes in his laboratory notes that Geralf can now replicate his creations with near-perfect accuracy.
events.quote: Geralf's prowess continues to grow.

events.summary: York sees crows in Kessig and nervously insists they are not an omen.
events.quote: No, no, it's just a murder of crows, not an omen of murder . . . I think.

events.summary: Ormendahl tells a human that power has a price and refuses to negotiate.
events.quote: Do not try to negotiate with me, human.

events.summary: By the sixth day of darkness, the lake is more blood than water.
events.quote: By the sixth day of darkness, the lake was more blood than water.

events.summary: Olivia Voldaren explains she prefers waitstaff with their bodies attached.
events.quote: I used to have hired hands, but I discovered they make better waitstaff with the rest of the body attached.

events.summary: The Headless Rider wanders the Moorlands seeking a worthy head.
events.quote: He wanders the Moorlands hoping to one day chop off a head worthy of replacing his own.

events.summary: Henrika praises demon blood over human blood.
events.quote: Once you've tasted demon blood, you'll wonder why you ever settled for human.

events.summary: Olivia's path of peril is a welcome to her guests and a warning to everyone else.
events.quote: To Olivia's guests, a welcome. To everyone else, a warning.

events.summary: Marel says that faith and fortitude let people mold change.
events.quote: We cannot escape change, but with faith and fortitude, we can mold it to our liking.

events.summary: A Kessig villager says his wolfrider partner protects the village and eats captured vampires.
events.quote: My village is safe from wolf attacks, and she gets to eat any vampires we catch.

events.summary: Villagers rise against Stensia's vampires, vowing to reclaim what was taken.
events.quote: Tonight, we reclaim what's ours!

events.summary: Wrenn says the seeds waited for the sun to rise again and are now rewarded.
events.quote: These seeds waited faithfully for the sun to rise again.

events.summary: Halana wants to follow a new, dangerous creature in the Ulvenwald.
events.quote: This could be an entirely new species! I say we follow it.

events.summary: Alena urges running from the Ulvenwald Behemoth.
events.quote: We've learned enough! I say we run.

events.summary: Dorothea says she cannot rest while a Voldaren lives.
events.quote: Every day a Voldaren draws breath is a day I cannot rest.

events.summary: Edgar resolves to correct how his kind took his gift for granted.
events.quote: Our kind has taken my gift for granted. It is time to correct that folly.

events.summary: Eruth is cursed with visions that all come true.
events.quote: She is cursed with visions of monsters and suffering . . . and all her visions come true.

events.summary: Olivia stages her wedding to unite the vampire bloodlines under her rule.
events.quote: Her grand wedding had one goal: to unite the vampire bloodlines under her rule.

relations.note: Sigarda breaks free of bindings while Olivia is distracted.
relations.quote: With Olivia distracted, Sigarda tore free from her bindings and summoned her Host of Herons.

relations.note: Olivia aims to unite the vampire bloodlines under her rule.
relations.quote: Her grand wedding had one goal: to unite the vampire bloodlines under her rule.

relations.note: Dorothea cannot rest while a Voldaren lives.
relations.quote: Every day a Voldaren draws breath is a day I cannot rest.

relations.note: Ludevic notes that Geralf can replicate his creations.
relations.quote: He can now replicate my own creations with near-perfect accuracy.
